_comment: Frozen parameters of the construction, transcribed from ao-prf_wProofs.tex. This is the intended single source of truth. See README.md 'Constants are duplicated, not shared' for the caveat: bip32-hydra.mpc currently carries its own copies in a different representation, and wiring it to this file would require modifying it (out of scope). test_constants.py checks all three copies agree.
d_source: tex sec.1 table: smallest odd integer with gcd(d, p-1) = 1
rounds_source: tex sec.1 table; R_E = 6 = 2 initial + 4 final
matrices_source: tex sec.1.2, given in plain form (actual entries)
round_constants_note: NOT SPECIFIED IN THE TEX. Derived via SHAKE128 seeded with 'Hydra' || label || the prime as little-endian 64-bit blocks, with labels 'Constants' (body then head) and 'Rolling'. Procedure taken from the Hydra authors' hydra.sage; see README 'Spec gaps'.
overflow_band_note: p - 2^128; a word is rejected iff its canonical value lies in [2^128, p). tex sec.7
